justification: Adds the email capture (conversion) step to /prospector: new SaveSearchCard component posting to the existing /api/verify-interest endpoint with source='prospector', a new PostHog track function, sidebar wiring in ProspectorClient, and a 5-case Jest suite. Four substantive files changed so the tier floor pushes this above Minor. No new API routes, no DB schema changes, no regulatory logic.

pre_impl.existing_data: Audited existing email capture before building: /api/verify-interest (verify_interest table, (email, source) unique upsert, Resend notification), /api/dcp-interest, and /api/canibuildit/lead all exist. verify_interest accepts arbitrary source strings (safeSource = source || 'assessment'), so source='prospector' reuses it with zero schema changes.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed a dedicated prospector_interest table would be needed; actual codebase already has a generic interest endpoint whose address column (free text, nullable) can carry the saved filter URL. Also assumed click-submit would exercise the regex validation path in tests; jsdom native email constraint validation blocked submission first, so the test submits the form element directly.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New: SaveSearchCard component, trackProspectorEmailCapture function, test file. Existing reused: /api/verify-interest endpoint and its rate limiting, EMAIL_REGEX pattern copied from that endpoint for client-side parity, serializeFilters from filter-params for the saved search URL, lib/analytics.ts track* pattern.

functions.name: SaveSearchCard
functions.input: Props lgaName string and filterQuery string from serializeFilters, plus user-typed email from controlled input state
functions.output: Renders idle form, submitting, success confirmation, or error states; POSTs JSON to /api/verify-interest and fires prospector_email_capture on success only
functions.if_none: Empty filterQuery sends bare /prospector path and has_filters false; invalid email is rejected client-side by regex before any network call happens

functions.name: trackProspectorEmailCapture
functions.input: Object with lga string and has_filters boolean describing the captured search context
functions.output: Calls posthog.capture with event name prospector_email_capture and the params object, same pattern as eight existing track functions
functions.if_none: If PostHog is uninitialised the capture call buffers or no-ops internally; identical exposure to every existing track function in production

functions.name: handleSubmit
functions.input: Form submit event; reads email state, lgaName and filterQuery props at submission time
functions.output: Sets status to done on HTTP 200, or error with the API-provided message or a generic retry message on failure
functions.if_none: Non-OK response with unparseable JSON body falls back to generic error text; analytics event is never fired on the failure path

values.value: filters.lga_name from URL-parsed ProspectorFilters passed as lgaName prop
values.read_at: frontend-nextjs/components/prospector/ProspectorClient.tsx render of SaveSearchCard in the sidebar
values.if_missing: parseFilters always returns a string (DEFAULT_FILTERS fallback 'INNER WEST'), so lgaName can never be undefined at this boundary

values.value: API error body data.error from /api/verify-interest non-OK responses
values.if_missing: res.json() failure or non-string error falls back to 'Something went wrong — try again' so the user always sees a retryable message

values.value: Optional role select value, constrained to ROLE_OPTIONS mirroring the endpoint's VALID_ROLES list
values.read_at: frontend-nextjs/components/prospector/SaveSearchCard.tsx role state in handleSubmit payload and analytics event
values.if_missing: Empty selection is sent as null; the endpoint independently re-validates against VALID_ROLES and stores null for anything unrecognised

queries: N/A — no database queries added or changed; the component posts to the existing /api/verify-interest endpoint whose INSERT ... ON CONFLICT upsert is unchanged

break_it.scenario: verify_interest upsert key is (email, source), so a user who saves one search and later saves a different filter set silently overwrites their previous saved search context
break_it.what_happens: The address column keeps only the most recent filter URL per email, losing the earlier saved search without telling the user anything
break_it.repro: Submit the form twice with the same email but different filters, then inspect the verify_interest row for that email and source
break_it.how: Accepted for launch: the lead (email + latest interest) is the asset, not a full saved-search history; a real saved-search feature would need its own table and is out of scope

break_it.scenario: A bot or hostile client bypasses the client-side regex and posts garbage emails directly, or hammers the form to spam the Resend notification inbox
break_it.what_happens: Junk rows accumulate in verify_interest and each one emails info@plotdetect.com.au, polluting the lead list this feature exists to build
break_it.repro: curl -X POST /api/verify-interest with a syntactically valid but fake email in a loop from one IP
break_it.how: Server re-validates with the same EMAIL_REGEX and returns 400; the (email, source) ON CONFLICT upsert deduplicates repeats, capping rows and limiting notification spam per unique email

break_it.scenario: User submits while a filter change is in flight, so the captured filterQuery prop reflects the previous render rather than what the user believes they saved
break_it.what_happens: The stored /prospector URL would reproduce slightly different results than the table the user was looking at when they submitted
break_it.repro: Click a filter checkbox and submit the email form in the same instant, then compare the stored address URL to the final page URL
break_it.how: filterQuery is derived from the same URL-backed filters object that drives the visible results table, and React renders both from one state pass, so prop and table can only diverge within a single frame

break_it.scenario: PostHog capture throws or the analytics module fails to load after the API call already succeeded
break_it.what_happens: The lead is stored but the funnel undercounts conversions, making channels look worse than they are in the launch scoreboard
break_it.repro: Block app.posthog.com in devtools network conditions and submit a valid email on the preview deployment
break_it.how: Success state is set before the track call, so the user experience never degrades; posthog-js buffers or drops silently rather than throwing, and the verify_interest GET endpoint remains the source of truth for lead counts

post_merge.db_reset: N/A — no schema changes; rows accumulate in the existing verify_interest table under source='prospector'
post_merge.secrets: None added — endpoint already uses RESEND_API_KEY and existing Supabase/Upstash env vars configured in Vercel
post_merge.other_repo: N/A — frontend-nextjs only, no cross-repo impact
post_merge.manual_verify: On the preview deployment submit a real email on /prospector, confirm the success state, the info@plotdetect.com.au notification email, the verify_interest row with source='prospector' and the filter URL in address, and a prospector_email_capture event in PostHog Activity
